# MSCHF

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 5 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A one-page drop index: black ground, grey uppercase mono at a viewport-scaled size, a gold square logo button, a 3px gold rule, and red for what is not released yet.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (the host has no account; the index and the Nuxt 404 are public). Themes: dark.

MSCHF's public site, https://mschf.com, captured signed out on 2026-11-19. The site is one dark index of drops. There is no account on this host, no light theme, and no second page in the sitemap. Widths: 1440x900 at 1x, and 390x844 at 2x (measured `innerWidth` 390, `devicePixelRatio` 2).

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The vw sizes are stored as the px computed at 1440. At another width they change. The phone row is a separate token (`typography.rowPhone`) from the 390 reading.

`light` is the name of the only semantic set. The page is black. There is no second theme to toggle.

The 3px rule computed as 2.5px (`0.208333vw` at 1440) and painted as 3px in the 1x screenshot. The token uses 3px.

`section.projects-upcoming-and-links` uses a red-to-black `border-image`. Its computed `border-left-color` is the Tailwind preflight `rgb(229, 231, 235)`, which is not what you see.

The marquee duration (50s, `steps(50)`) is one running row, not a system scale.

Screenshots are 256-colour PNGs. Read colour from the tokens.

MSCHFSansMono is not in this package. Specimens fall back to ui-monospace.

The 128px icon is a nearest-neighbour scale of the 32px favicon. There is no larger icon on the host.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Set the page black and the type grey.** The ground is `#000000` and the ink is `#84898e`. See [home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png).
- **Set titles in one uppercase mono size.** At 1440 that size is 65px on a 56px line. See [list-row-default.png](components/crops/list-row-default.png).
- **Turn a title white on hover, and clear the gold on the logo.** See [home-dark-link-hover.png](screenshots/home-dark-link-hover.png) and [home-dark-logo-hover.png](screenshots/home-dark-logo-hover.png).
- **Keep corners square.** Every painted radius is 0.
- **Use the gold rule for released work.** The rule is `rgba(168, 145, 65, 0.3)`. The three link rows at the bottom are gold, blue, and red, one each. See [home-dark-upcoming.png](screenshots/home-dark-upcoming.png).
- **Do not invent a light theme, a card, or a form.** The page does not have them.
- **Do not restyle store.mschf.com with these tokens.** That shop is a separate Shopify theme.
